mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS monthly_id, m.year_month, m.employee_id, e.employee_no AS employee_code, e.employee_name, w.workplace_name, dept.department_name, m.scheduled_days, m.attendance_days, m.normal_days, m.late_count, m.early_leave_count, m.missing_punch_count, m.absence_count, m.exception_days, m.paid_leave_days, m.rest_days, m.close_status, m.block_reason_count, m.updated_at FROM attendance_monthly m INNER JOIN employee e ON e.id = m.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = m.tenant_id LEFT JOIN workplace w ON w.id = m.workplace_id AND w.tenant_id = m.tenant_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = m.department_id AND dept.tenant_id = m.tenant_id WHERE ORDER BY m.employee_id ASC, m.year_month ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM attendance_monthly m INNER JOIN employee e ON e.id = m.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = m.tenant_id WHERE
SELECT m.close_status AS closeStatus, COUNT(1) AS total FROM attendance_monthly m INNER JOIN employee e ON e.id = m.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = m.tenant_id WHERE GROUP BY m.close_status

SELECT m.id AS monthly_id, m.year_month, m.employee_id, e.employee_no AS employee_code, e.employee_name, w.workplace_name, dept.department_name, m.scheduled_days, m.attendance_days, m.normal_days, m.late_count, m.early_leave_count, m.missing_punch_count, m.absence_count, m.exception_days, m.paid_leave_days, m.rest_days, m.close_status, m.block_reason_count, m.closed_at, m.closed_by, m.reopened_at, m.reopened_by, m.remark, m.updated_at FROM attendance_monthly m INNER JOIN employee e ON e.id = m.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = m.tenant_id LEFT JOIN workplace w ON w.id = m.workplace_id AND w.tenant_id = m.tenant_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = m.department_id AND dept.tenant_id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.id = #{id}

SELECT d.id AS daily_id, d.work_date, d.work_day_type, CONCAT(COALESCE(st.template_name, ''), CASE WHEN st.start_time IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' ', st.start_time, '-', st.end_time) END) AS schedule_label, d.status, d.final_status, d.handling_status, d.exception_flag, d.locked_flag FROM attendance_monthly m INNER JOIN attendance_daily d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.employee_id = m.employee_id AND FORMATDATETIME(d.work_date, 'yyyy-MM') = m.year_month LEFT JOIN shift_schedule ss ON ss.id = d.shift_schedule_id AND ss.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN shift_template st ON st.id = ss.shift_template_id AND st.tenant_id = ss.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.id = #{monthlyId} ORDER BY d.work_date ASC, d.id ASC

SELECT d.work_date AS workDate, d.handling_status AS handlingStatus, d.exception_flag AS exceptionFlag, d.locked_flag AS lockedFlag, d.final_status AS finalStatus FROM attendance_monthly m INNER JOIN attendance_daily d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.employee_id = m.employee_id AND FORMATDATETIME(d.work_date, 'yyyy-MM') = m.year_month WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.id = #{monthlyId} ORDER BY d.work_date ASC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO attendance_monthly ( tenant_id, year_month, employee_id, workplace_id, department_id, scheduled_days, attendance_days, normal_days, late_count, early_leave_count, missing_punch_count, absence_count, exception_days, paid_leave_days, rest_days, close_status, block_reason_count, closed_at, closed_by, reopened_at, reopened_by, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted_flag ) KEY (tenant_id, year_month, employee_id) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{yearMonth}, #{employeeId}, #{workplaceId}, #{departmentId}, #{scheduledDays}, #{attendanceDays}, #{normalDays}, #{lateCount}, #{earlyLeaveCount}, #{missingPunchCount}, #{absenceCount}, #{exceptionDays}, #{paidLeaveDays}, #{restDays}, #{closeStatus}, #{blockReasonCount}, #{closedAt}, #{closedBy}, #{reopenedAt}, #{reopenedBy}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_monthly SET close_status = #{closeStatus}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, closed_by = #{closedBy}, reopened_at = #{reopenedAt}, reopened_by = #{reopenedBy}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
